title: Microporous Structure of a Chain Compound of Copper(II) Benzoate Bridged by Pyrazine
abstract: Abstract                Reaction of copper(II) benzoate with pyrazine (pyz) gave a compound, [Cu2(bz)4(pyz)]n (1) which has a gas-occlusion property. The X-ray structure analysis of 1·2nCH3CN shows a microporous structure formed by chains where the carboxylate dimer units are linked by pyrazine molecules.
